d: Short honey-blonde hair styled in a side ponytail with long bangs framing a youthful, teenage face and wide, dark grey eyes. A slender build wearing a white short-sleeved shirt under a sleeveless dark grey vest, paired with a red bow tie and a matching dark grey pleated mini-skirt with a light grey belt.
